notes.title: Updated to version 1.15.3
notes.notes:
【Updated to version 1.15.3】

During the period from the launch of the game to now, we would like to thank everyone for your support and feedback, which has let us know that there are still many areas for improvement in the game. If there are still deficiencies or dissatisfaction in the future, please continue to give us your advice. Your encouragement and support are the driving force for us to become better!

In response to the issue that some maps are too large, we have made the following corrections.

1. Add fast movement options to some maps without affecting the plot performance.

2. Fixed typos and character picture errors
